verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation, such as rules or alerts on new register entries or announcements, is a fair capability to ask of a public company-register portal, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents search, register access, announcements and a publication platform for submitting orders. Nothing shows user-definable rules, event triggers or automated actions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
